en: Colorized street scene with outdoor café tables under large awnings in front of ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. Caption on the picture reads "Brașov, Brassó, Kronstadt," indicating the city in Romanian, Hungarian, and German. The reverse has Romanian postal cancellations, a Romanian stamp, and handwriting addressed to Bucharest. A printed caption on the back mentions the Prefecture with the Transylvania Café.
